sentences.text:
... Opposite Party Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar For
the Petitioners : Ms. Neeharika Mazumdar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Mishra,
A.P.P. Order No. 03 Dated: 13.09.2024 The petitioners apprehending their arrest for the offences
punishable under Sections 379/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 21(a) of the Mines and
Minerals (Development & Regulation) Act, 1957, rules 4/54 of the Jharkhand Minor Mineral
Concession Rules, 2004 and rules 7/9 of the Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of Illegal Mining,
Transportation and Storage) Rules, 2017, have prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case and have not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

The petitioner no. 1 is the owner of the truck bearing registration no. WB-65C-4902 whereas the petitioner no. 2 is the driver of said vehicle from which there is alleged recovery of about 800 cft. of stone chips without valid paper.
In fact, there has been no such recovery from the said truck.
The false implication of the petitioners would be evident from the fact that the seizure list prepared in this regard does not bear signature of any independent witness.
Otherwise also, the seizure list does not mention the quantity of stone chips.
The petitioners have no criminal antecedent as has been stated in paragraph-18 of the present anticipatory bail application.
Hence, they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P. opposes the petitioners' prayer for anticipatory bail.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

5. Accordingly, the petitioners, above named, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Rajmahal in connection with Taljhari P.S.
